CAALM powered by Pega Blueprint is a game-changer in transforming a legacy application to a cloud native app that’ll enable innovation and business agility.

### Overview


The future of businesses is autonomous. AI and automation are steadily becoming the norm across enterprises, as businesses increasingly gravitate towards next-gen technologies like agentic AI and AI-powered automation. These innovations enable future-ready capabilities, enhance agility, and unlock potential. Turn decades of legacy into modernization-ready insights in days - not months. Leveraging our AI-powered legacy modernization workbench, we accelerate legacy documentation, streamline source code analysis, and craft strategic business cases for transformation - laying the foundation for future-ready applications. With Pega Blueprint and Pega Agents, organizations can fast-track their path to measurable value. CAALM, an all-encompassing solution for modifying legacy systems to: - Automate legacy code analysis and AI-driven legacy app documentation - Create compelling business cases to unlock value - Fast-track analysis and migration of applications and data based on best practices


### Key Features


- Legacy Transformation
- Automated code analysis
- Application landscape assessment
- Agentic application development
- Business re-imagination
